_about: The floor the labelled retrieval set must reach (Sales ticket 45). Measured 2026-11-15 on the in-memory index with the hash embedder: hybrid recall@5 1.0, nDCG@5 0.76, p95 about 2 ms; dense alone recall@5 0.70, nDCG@5 0.54; BM25 alone recall@5 0.70. The floor sits between, so dropping either leg or the fusion fails it. The latency bound catches an accidental full scan or a quadratic step, not a slow CI machine.
